# OpenReview

> > OpenReview is a scientific publishing platform enabling open peer review, transparent collaboration, and community-driven evaluation across major AI and machine learning conferences.

OpenReview hosts peer review and submission management for leading academic venues including ICLR, NeurIPS, and ACL. The platform promotes transparency and openness in the academic review process while supporting workshops, conferences, and collaborative research initiatives.

## Key Topics

- open peer review
- scientific publishing
- peer-review transparency
- conference submissions

- [Venue Directory](https://openreview.net/venues): Directory of academic conferences and venues using OpenReview

- [A Message from AI Research Leaders: Join Us in Supporting OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum/pineau|a_message_from_ai_research_leaders_join_us_in_supporting_openreview): Fundraising message from AI leaders including Bengio, Ng, and Pineau
- [Survey Finds Broad Support for Greater Openness in AI Peer Review](https://openreview.net/forum/shah|survey_finds_broad_support_for_greater_openness_in_ai_peer_review): Survey on peer review openness in AI research community by Shah & McCallum
